$Comment: Voidhearts a Disenchanting Table found, rung 2 of the disenchanting_voidheart ladder. An exact item id; a Voidheart is the table's rarest find, gated to the deepest gear, so even the first rung is a real chase and the top one is a long career. STATION_OUTPUT counts a stack the moment it lands in the worker's inventory. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts BOTH tables (the greater table's station id starts with the lesser's); a qualifier left out would count the same item at the Sawmill too, so every disenchanting count names it.
Name: Disenchanting_Voidheart_T2
